evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: Using MULTISPEECHQA, we also introduce MULTISPEECH-BENCH, a multi-task benchmark for evaluating SLM performance on 23 languages.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Speech Language Models (SLMs) that understand spoken language questions support only a few high-resource languages, limiting access to millions of people worldwide.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We compare the performance of a cascading system to open-weight and closed SLMs on MULTISPEECH-BENCH and find that the cascading system outperforms open-weight SLMs but not all closed SLMs.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We present MULTISPEECHQA, a large-scale, synthetically generated and human-verified dataset comprising 9200 hours of 10.8 million spoken question-answer pairs in 23 typologically diverse languages.
